mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, we have clear skies with a pleasant temperature of 73 degrees near the Verona Public Library and a waxing gibbous moon phase.
In city news, the Verona Police Department has published their weekly activity report for the period of August 17 through August 24, detailing various community safety incidents and service calls.
We have plenty happening in town. Yoga at Insight Wellness is taking place today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, residents can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's.
Among the incidents reported this week, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on August 19 at North Main Street and Bering Drive, resulting in minor injuries.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch, and you have plenty of time to enjoy a scoop since the store is open until 10 PM.
